facts.statement: The genus Protolamna was described by Cappetta in 1985.
Protolamna sokolovi is the type species of the genus Protolamna.
Fossils of Protolamna indicate that gigantism evolved early in the history of lamniform sharks.
facts.quote: Protolamna fossils indicate gigantism evolved early on in the history of lamniforms.

facts.statement: Protolamna is the oldest-known gigantic lamniform shark.
facts.quote: This makes Protolamna the oldest-known gigantic lamniform.

facts.statement: Seven species are currently attributed to the genus Protolamna.
facts.quote: Seven species are currently attributed to this genus

facts.statement: The parent group of the genus Protolamna is Pseudoscapanorhynchidae.
Protolamna belongs to the family Pseudoscapanorhynchidae.
Protolamna is classified in the class Chondrichthyes.
Protolamna lived from the Valanginian to the Maastrichtian, spanning from 137.05 to 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Valanginian to Maastrichtian (137.05 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: There are 82 recorded fossil occurrences of Protolamna in the Paleobiology Database.
